summary: Iter65 · P1 (Halting Verify) + P3 (XLSX sample) + P4 (Reactivation Guard) end-to-end verified. Backend regression: 10/10 GREEN (test_iter65_halting_verify.py 6/6 + new test_iter65_xlsx_and_reactivation.py 4/4). Frontend E2E via Playwright: (a) /reports/halting-verify renders with all 4 stat tiles (stat-total/stat-ok/stat-mismatch + verdict card 'ALL GREEN — safe to enable SMS Digest' when mismatch_count=0), filters and refresh work, only-mismatches checkbox correctly hides OK rows. (b) Vehicles page bulk-import-modal exposes 'Excel (.xlsx)' link → downloads vehicles_sample_import.xlsx (6383 bytes, PK magic, 'Vehicles' + 'Instructions' sheets, 3 sample rows). (c) P4 reactivation guard: for a vehicle deactivated 100 days ago, the status dialog shows vehicle-reactivate-warning ('This vehicle has been INACTIVE for 100 days', last_status_change_effective_date + reason rendered), the acknowledgement checkbox exists and is initially unchecked, vehicle-status-confirm is DISABLED with valid reason+date until the check is ticked, then enables. For a vehicle deactivated 10 days ago the warning banner is NOT rendered and confirm gates only on reason ≥3 + effective_date. Backend PATCH /vehicles/{vid}/status permits the reactivation and adds a 'reactivated' row to /vehicles/{vid}/status-audit (audit contains both actions).
action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: /app/backend/routers/reports.py lines 1163-1179 contain an orphan duplicate of _public_base_url body (unreachable code after the correct return above) — dead code, should be removed.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py has ~15 lines of orphan/duplicated code (lines 1163-1179) after the `_public_base_url` function — an unreachable copy of the same function body. Harmless but noise.

HaltingVerify.jsx `okCount` is derived from `rows.filter(status==='OK').length` while `mismatch_count` comes from server. When only_mismatches=true the server strips OK rows, so stat-ok reads 0 even though the underlying data-set has OK trips. Consider deriving okCount as `data.total - data.mismatch_count` so the tile stays truthful across filter states.
Vehicles.jsx now 617 lines — still under the 700-line guideline but growing; the Status Dialog + Reactivation Guard block (lines 440-510) is a natural extraction candidate.
